top_choice_rationale: P001 (Katori and Ye, optical lattice clock) rewards a demonstrated and independently reproduced change in measurement regime: magic-wavelength trapping of many atoms cancels the trap light shift so statistical and systematic uncertainty improve together, giving 10^-18 in hours of averaging, confirmed at JILA, RIKEN/Tokyo, NIST, PTB and SYRTE. It is distinct from the 2005 comb and 2012 single-quantum-system prizes, mature, and the two-name allocation is clean, provided the citation names the lattice architecture; the priority record (Takamoto, Lemonde, Ludlow) should be confirmed. P002 (magic-angle twisted bilayer graphene) is a strong, reproduced new platform but younger, with the pairing mechanism open and Cao and other first authors outside the three-name credit. Either is preferable to no award.
recusal_note: none apparent from profile for P001 or P002; my rare-earth-crystal quantum-memory work would be a conflict only for B007, which is not in this slate
